description.value: A lakeside off-grid campground directly on Dease Lake along the Cassiar Highway, with a complimentary boat launch for registered guests; no potable water on site and pit toilets only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an off-grid campground at Dease Lake with 25 sites (some pull-through, some tent), pit toilets, WiFi, and a boat launch. It explicitly states 'NO POTABLE WATER, POWER OR SEWER HOOKUPS,' providing clear negative evidence for potable water and device/e-bike charging. OSM tags largely align with the website. The phone number matches between OSM and website; the address differs only in notation ('BC 37 North' vs 'Highway 37 North'). The business name is spelled 'Watersedge' (one word) on the website but 'Waters Edge' (two words) in OSM.
concerns: Name spelling discrepancy: OSM has 'Waters Edge Campground' (two words) while the website uses 'Watersedge Campground' (one word)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A functional campground on Highway 37 that accepts tents, directly relevant to touring cyclists on the Stewart-Cassiar. Limited amenities but one of very few options in this remote stretch.

wow_evidence: explicitly states 'NO POTABLE WATER, POWER OR SEWER HOOKUPS'
